title: The solubility of oxygen in the major sea salts and their mixtures at 25 C (F.J. Millero, F. Huang, A.L. Laferiere)
needs_pass2_reason: text layer clean; every cell matched the 200 dpi page images; no corrections
experimental_method: Solutions equilibrated with water-vapour-saturated air at 25 +-0.02 C for 4-40 h in a 2 L jacketed vessel; dissolved O2 by Winkler titration (Carpenter modification, photometric end point); molality from solution density (Mettler densimeter).
uncertainties_stated: Duplicate measurements agree to 0.2-1 umol/kg (0.3%); fit standard errors 0.5-3.1 umol/kg; atmospheric pressure to +-1 mbar; T +-0.02 C.
quality_remarks: Solutions made by volume, converted to molality via densities (Lo Surdo et al., 1982). Water-vapour-pressure correction to 1 atm neglected. Four printed zero-salt references differ (258.1 NaCl; 258.9 for the other single salts; 258.5 in mixtures; Table 1 gives 258.9 at 25.12 C). Table 1 shows 2.6 umol/kg deviation at 45 C in water (authors attribute partly to extrapolation); seawater units in Table 1 ambiguous (footnote b). Caption of Table 6 has a missing comma.
not_extracted_tables: Table 3: fit coefficients of Eqn. 10 (model parameters)
Table 4: NaCl O2 solubility converted to umol/L and compared with Sherwood et al. equations (derived from Table 2 and a literature model)
Table 10, Seawater block: calculated values from Eqn. 9 and model, no measurements (the Dead Sea block with measured values IS extracted)

row_counts.Table 5: printed 8+7 per mixture (+ 2 run labels), written 17 rows each in table_5_group1-2

extraction_notes: Side-by-side blocks of Tables 2, 5, 6 written as separate table_N_groupK files (different salts/column headers). Printed superscript letters: only Table 6 footnote b (last row of MgCl2 + MgSO4 block) and Table 1 'c' (values in parentheses, Weiss 1970) are carried; Table 1 Calculated column holds 'Garcia-Gordon (Weiss)' pairs as printed. All gas data are for O2 in air-saturated solutions at 1 atm total pressure; the paper does not define standard conditions.
pass2_diff: Tables 1, 2, 5, 6, 10: pass 1 split by block into group files; all values match pass 2.
